# Project Scope

## Purpose

State what this authority controls and link governance for scope-change rules.

## Current accepted product boundary

State the current accepted product boundary only.

## Accepted capabilities

List accepted product capabilities at boundary level; link narrower executable authorities rather than duplicating design.

## Durable exclusions

Record only exclusions that remain meaningful across current work. Use-case-specific non-goals belong with their Goal/issue unless they are durable project exclusions.

## Scope admission rule

State how new capability or use-case scope becomes accepted; reference governance/workflow rather than duplicating procedure.
